overview.description: The Calamos S&P 500 Structured Alt Protection ETF - September (CPST) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in downside hedge alternatives. The fund seeks to track the return of the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY), to a cap, with 100% downside hedge over a one-year outcome period. The actively managed fund holds FLEX options to obtain exposure CPST was launched on Sep 3, 2024 and is issued by Calamos.

data.title: Calamos Announces Launch and Upside Cap Rates for CPST and CPNS: Structured Protection ETFs Providing Exposure to S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 with 100% Downside Protection Over One Year
